signature.caption: he just files issues
signature.why: Our pick: each project gets a standing Copilot lead that triages, tests, merges and cleans up, so his input is the issue tracker.
signature.quote: I've moved on to just assigning each project a lead in @GitHub Copilot and making everything their problem.

archetype.why: Each project has a Copilot lead agent that runs the sessions; he files the issues.

signature_quote.value: I work with AI every single day, and what I’m finding is that less is way more.
signature_quote.more: It’s not about what I install or configure or trick the agent into doing that makes any real difference.
